parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/PlaylistFetcherTests.swift`. Although the two test methods `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnError` (line 45) and `fetchPlaylistReturnsEmptyOnDecodingError` (line 84) share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8), they are deliberately distinct test cases exercising different failure modes — a network error path versus a decoding error path. Merging or abstracting them would obscure the intent of each failure scenario and couple unrelated error semantics under a single test body, reducing diagnostic clarity when either test fails.
